function listing(route){if(!state.profile)return profileGate();const n=nutrition(state.profile);let pool=catalogue.filter(r=>compatible(r,state.profile));if(route==='panier')pool=pool.filter(r=>isForFoodCloudRoute(r,'panier')&&(r.routes&&r.routes.length||r.tags.includes('mediterraneen')));if(route==='personnalisees')pool=pool.filter(r=>isForFoodCloudRoute(r,'personnalisees')&&r.meals.includes(selectedMeal)&&(!n.target||Math.abs(r.kcal-n.target*fractions[selectedMeal])<=n.target*fractions[selectedMeal]*.25));if(route==='chef')pool=pool.filter(r=>isForFoodCloudRoute(r,'chef'));if(filter)pool=pool.filter(r=>(r.title+' '+r.ingredients.map(i=>i.name).join(' ')).toLocaleLowerCase('fr').includes(filter.toLocaleLowerCase('fr')));if(route==='chef'&&pool.length)pool=[pool[Math.floor(Math.random()*pool.length)]];return`<a href="#cuisine">← Les trois façons de cuisiner</a><h1>${route==='panier'?'Le panier bleu':route==='chef'?'La surprise du chef':'Vos recettes personnalisées'}</h1><p class="muted">${route==='panier'?'Les recettes que vous avez choisies pour votre panier bleu.':route==='chef'?'Une découverte aléatoire parmi les recettes du chef compatibles avec le profil.':'Des recettes compatibles avec le profil, le repas choisi et le repère calorique.'}</p>${demoNotice()}${route==='personnalisees'&&!n.target?'<div class="notice">Filtrage par préférences uniquement : aucun objectif calorique défini pour votre profil.</div>':''}<form id="search-form" class="toolbar"><input aria-label="Rechercher une recette" name="query" placeholder="Une recette, un ingrédient…" value="${esc(filter)}">${route==='personnalisees'?`<select name="meal" aria-label="Repas" style="width:auto">${Object.entries(mealNames).map(([k,v])=>`<option value="${k}" ${selectedMeal===k?'selected':''}>${v}</option>`).join('')}</select>`:''}<button>Rechercher</button>${route==='chef'?'<button type="button" class="secondary" data-action="refresh">Une autre idée</button>':''}</form>${recipeCards(pool)}`;}

function normalizeLeftover(value){return String(value??'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLocaleLowerCase('fr').trim();}
function showLeftoverResults(tokens,invented){const tokenSet=[...new Set(tokens)],matches=catalogue.filter(recipe=>compatible(recipe,state.profile)&&!recipe.generated).map(recipe=>{const '),card=(entry,index)=>`<article class="leftover-match ${index===0?'is-best':''}"><div class="leftover-match-top"><span class="leftover-score">${entry.score} ingrédient${entry.score>1?'s':''} function render(){const route=location.hash.slice(1)||'accueil';const view={accueil:home,profil:profile,cuisine,recettes:cuisine,personnalisees:()=>listing('personnalisees'),panier:()=>listing('panier'),chef:()=>listing('chef'),calendrier:calendar,courses,restes:leftovers,donnees:dataPage}[route]||home;$('#app').innerHTML=(route==='accueil'?'':'<div class="wrap">')+(storageError?'<div class="notice">Le stockage de ce navigateur n’a pas pu être lu.</div>':'')+(loadError?`<div class="notice error">${esc(loadError)} <button data-action="retry">Réessayer</button></div>`:'')+view()+(route==='accueil'?'':'</div>');$('#profile-link .dot').hidden=!!state.profile;document.querySelectorAll('.top nav a').forEach(a=>{if(a.hash===location.hash||route==='accueil'&&a.hash==='#accueil')a.setAttribute('aria-current','page');else a.removeAttribute('aria-current');});document.title='NutriChef · '+(route==='accueil'?'Accueil':route);}
function openRecipe(id){const r=catalogue.find(r=>r.id===id);if(!r)return;modalRecipe=r;$('#recipe-body').innerHTML=`<div class="eyebrow">${r.generated?'Improvisation de Pipo · calories estimées':'Recette NutriChef'}</div><h2>${esc(r.title)}</h2><p>${r.kcal} kcal / portion · ${r.minutes||25} minutes</p><p class="muted">Allergènes / exclusions déclarés : ${r.exclusions.length?r.exclusions.map(esc).join(', '):'aucun'}. function updateIngredients(){const p=Number($('#recipe-portions').value);$('#ingredient-list').innerHTML='<h3>Ingrédients</h3><ul>'+modalRecipe.ingredients.map(i=>`<li>${fmt(i.qty*p)} ${esc(i.unit)} de ${esc(i.name)}</li>`).join('')+'</ul>';}
function getPortions(){const input=$('#recipe-portions');if(!input.reportValidity())return null;return Number(input.value);}
function upsertWeight(date,weight){state.weights=state.weights.filter(w=>w.date!==date);state.weights.push({date,weight});state.weights.sort((a,b)=>a.date.localeCompare(b.date));state.profile.weight=state.weights.at(-1).weight;}
document.addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();const f=e.target,d=new FormData(f);if(f.id==='profile-form'){for(const [k,v]of d)if(k!=='exclusions')draft[k]=v;if(step===1)draft.special=d.has('special');if(step===2){draft.exclusions=d.getAll('exclusions');for(const k of ['age','weight','height','activity'])draft[k]=Number(draft[k]);draft.firstName=draft.firstName.trim();if(!draft.firstName){step=0;render();return;}state.profile={...draft};upsertWeight(isoDate(),draft.weight);editing=false;step=0;save();toast('Votre profil est enregistré.');}else step++;render();}
if(f.id==='weight-form'){upsertWeight(d.get('date'),Number(d.get('weight')));save();render();toast('Votre poids et vos repères ont été actualisés.');}
if(f.id==='search-form'){filter=d.get('query').trim();selectedMeal=d.get('meal')||selectedMeal;render();}
if(f.id==='shopping-form'){const name=d.get('name').trim();if(!name)return;addIngredients(state.shopping,{ingredients:[{name,qty:Number(d.get('qty')),unit:d.get('unit')}]});save();render();}
if(f.id==='plan-recipe'){if(!state.profile){$('#recipe-modal').close();location.hash='profil';return;}const p=getPortions();if(!p)return;const date=d.get('date'),slot=d.get('slot');state.menus[date]??={};if(state.menus[date][slot]&&!confirm('Remplacer le repas déjà prévu ?'))return;state.menus[date][slot]={id:modalRecipe.id,portions:p};save();$('#recipe-modal').close();toast('Recette ajoutée au calendrier.');render();}
if(f.id==='leftovers-form'){const tokens=d.get('ingredients').split(/[,;\n]+/).map(x=>x.trim().toLocaleLowerCase('fr')).filter(Boolean);if(!tokens.length){toast('Ajoutez au moins un ingrédient.');return;}const invented=inventRecipe(tokens,state.profile);if(invented){state.custom??=[];state.custom.push(invented);catalogue.push(invented);save();}showLeftoverResults(tokens,invented);}
});
document.addEventListener('change',e=>{const el=e.target;if(el.dataset.check){const i=state.shopping.find(x=>x.id===el.dataset.check);if(i){i.done=el.checked;save();render();}return;}if(el.dataset.meal&&el.value){const[date,slot]=el.dataset.meal.split('|');state.menus[date]??={};state.menus[date][slot]={id:el.value,portions:1};save();render();}if(el.dataset.portions){if(!el.reportValidity())return;const[date,slot]=el.dataset.portions.split('|');state.menus[date][slot].portions=Number(el.value);save();render();}if(el.id==='recipe-portions')updateIngredients();if(el.id==='menu-search'){filter=el.value.trim();render();}});
document.addEventListener('click',async e=>{const open=e.target.closest('[data-open]');if(open){e.preventDefault();openRecipe(open.dataset.open);return;}if(e.target.closest('.close'))$('#recipe-modal').close();const del=e.target.closest('[data-delete-item]');if(del){state.shopping=state.shopping.filter(x=>x.id!==del.dataset.deleteItem);save();render();}const remove=e.target.closest('[data-remove-meal]');if(remove){const[date,slot]=remove.dataset.removeMeal.split('|');delete state.menus[date][slot];save();render();}const action=e.target.closest('[data-action]')?.dataset.action;if(!action)return;
if(action==='add-leftover'){const input=$('#leftover-ingredients'),item=e.target.closest('[data-leftover-item]')?.dataset.leftoverItem;if(input&&item){const current=input.value.split(/[,;\n]+/).map(value=>value.trim()).filter(Boolean);if(!current.some(value=>normalizeLeftover(value)===normalizeLeftover(item)))current.push(item);input.value=current.join(', ');input.focus();}return;}if(action==='open-calendar-day'){calendarDay=e.target.closest('[data-calendar-date]')?.dataset.calendarDate||calendarDay;render();return;}if(action==='start-profile'){e.preventDefault();draft=state.profile?structuredClone(state.profile):{};step=0;editing=true;location.hash='profil';render();return;}if(action==='edit-profile'){draft=structuredClone(state.profile);step=0;editing=true;render();}
if(action==='profile-back'){const form=$('#profile-form');if(form){const fd=new FormData(form);for(const[k,v]of fd)if(k!=='exclusions')draft[k]=v;if(step===1)draft.special=fd.has('special');if(step===2)draft.exclusions=fd.getAll('exclusions');}if(step){step--;render();}else{editing=false;location.hash=state.profile?'profil':'accueil';render();}}
if(action==='greet-pipo'){
  const pipo=e.target.closest('.pipo-greeting'),hero=pipo?.closest('.hero'),first=state.profile?.firstName?.trim();
  if(pipo&&hero){
    pipo.dataset.cookingSrc??=pipo.currentSrc||pipo.src;
    const waveSrc=pipo.dataset.heySrc,talkSrc=pipo.dataset.talkSrc;
    pipo.src=waveSrc;
    hero.classList.add('pipo-says-hey');
    const bubble=hero.querySelector('.pipo-hello');
    if(bubble)bubble.textContent=first?`Hey ${first} !`:'Hey !';
    clearTimeout(window.pipoHelloTimer);
    clearInterval(window.pipoTalkTimer);
    let talking=false;
    window.pipoTalkTimer=setInterval(()=>{talking=!talking;pipo.src=talking?talkSrc:waveSrc;},240);
    window.pipoHelloTimer=setTimeout(()=>{clearInterval(window.pipoTalkTimer);pipo.src=pipo.dataset.cookingSrc;hero.classList.remove('pipo-says-hey');},3000);
  }
  toast(first?`Bonjour ${first} ! Prêt à cuisiner ensemble ?`:'Bonjour ! Je suis Pipo. Créons votre profil pour cuisiner ensemble.');
  return;
} if(action==='refresh-catalogue'){refreshCatalogue({renderView:true,notify:true});return;}if(action==='refresh')render();
if(action==='prev-week'||action==='next-week'){week+=action==='prev-week'?-1:1;calendarDay='';render();}
if(action==='auto-menu'){try{const next=buildMenu(catalogue,state.profile,dates());if(dates().some(d=>Object.keys(state.menus[d]||{}).length)&&!confirm('Remplacer les menus de cette semaine par la proposition de Pipo ?'))return;Object.assign(state.menus,next);save();render();toast('Vos menus de la semaine sont prêts.');}catch(err){toast(err.message);}}
if(action==='week-shopping'){const meals=dates().flatMap(d=>Object.values(state.menus[d]||{}));if(!meals.length){toast('Ajoutez d’abord des repas au calendrier.');return;}if(!confirm('Ajouter tous les ingrédients de cette semaine ? Un nouvel ajout cumulera les quantités.'))return;for(const m of meals){const r=catalogue.find(r=>r.id===m.id);if(r&&compatible(r,state.profile))addIngredients(state.shopping,r,m.portions);}save();toast('Ingrédients compatibles ajoutés à la liste.');}
if(action==='recipe-shopping'){const p=getPortions();if(!p)return;if(!compatible(modalRecipe,state.profile)){toast('Cette recette ne respecte pas votre profil.');return;}addIngredients(state.shopping,modalRecipe,p);save();toast('Ingrédients ajoutés à votre liste.');}
if(action==='print-shopping'){window.print();return;}if(action==='download-shopping-image'){downloadShoppingImage();return;}if(action==='clear-checked'){state.shopping=state.shopping.filter(i=>!i.done);save();render();}
if(action==='copy-shopping'){try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(state.shopping.filter(i=>!i.done).map(i=>`${i.name} : ${fmt(i.qty)} ${i.unit}`).join('\n'));toast('Liste copiée.');}catch{toast('Copie indisponible dans ce navigateur.');}}
if(action==='export'){const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([JSON.stringify(state,null,2)],{type:'application/json'}));const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download='nutrichef-mes-donnees.json';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);}
if(action==='erase'&&confirm('Effacer définitivement votre profil, vos pesées, vos menus et vos courses sur cet appareil ?')){state={profile:null,weights:[],menus:{},shopping:[]};draft={};step=0;editing=false;save();location.hash='accueil';render();}
if(action==='retry')await load();});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter'&&e.target.dataset.action==='greet-pipo'){e.preventDefault();e.target.click();}});window.addEventListener('hashchange',()=>{filter='';render();window.scrollTo(0,0);});
let catalogueUpdatedAt=0,catalogueRefreshBusy=false;async function refreshCatalogue(options={}){const {renderView=false,notify=false}=options;if(catalogueRefreshBusy)return false;catalogueRefreshBusy=true;try{const data=await getRecipes();catalogue=[...data.recipes,...(state.custom||[])];demo=false;loadError='';catalogueUpdatedAt=Date.now();if(renderView)render();if(notify)toast('Catalogue FoodCloud actualisé : '+data.recipes.length+' recette'+(data.recipes.length>1?'s':'')+' disponible'+(data.recipes.length>1?'s':'')+'.');return true;}catch(e){if(!catalogue.length){loadError='FoodCloud est momentanément inaccessible. Vérifiez votre connexion puis réessayez.';if(renderView)render();}if(notify)toast('Impossible d’actualiser le catalogue pour le moment.');return false;}finally{catalogueRefreshBusy=false;}}async function load(){await refreshCatalogue({renderView:false});render();}setInterval(()=>{if(document.visibilityState==='visible')refreshCatalogue();},120000);document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.visibilityState==='visible'&&Date.now()-catalogueUpdatedAt>30000)refreshCatalogue();});
render();await load();

})();
const nutrichefIcon=document.createElement('link');
nutrichefIcon.rel='icon';nutrichefIcon.type='image/svg+xml';nutrichefIcon.href='nutrichef-icon.svg';
document.head.appendChild(nutrichefIcon);
const nutrichefAppleIcon=document.createElement('link');
nutrichefAppleIcon.rel='apple-touch-icon';nutrichefAppleIcon.href='nutrichef-icon.svg';
document.head.appendChild(nutrichefAppleIcon);
</script></body></html>
